Name: TALK_PARAM_ST
Description: Lines of dialogue and radio comms: the subtitle text, voice, speaker, timing and sound effects of each line.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Rows set to ON are excluded from the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Release Version
Fields.Description: Rows set to ON are excluded from the product version.

Fields.Name: Return Position
Fields.Description: Relative position of the conversation to return to.

Fields.Name: Event ID
Fields.Description: Event ID linked to the line.

Fields.Name: Start Delay Time
Fields.Description: Delay before the text is shown and the voice starts. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Start SE
Fields.Description: Sound played when the subtitle starts. -1: automatic; 0: none; 1 or more: that sound ID.

Fields.Name: End SE
Fields.Description: Sound played when the subtitle ends. -1: automatic; 0: none; 1 or more: that sound ID.

Fields.Name: Character Name Text ID
Fields.Description: Speaker of the line, as the speaker's account param ID. Sets the name shown with the subtitle.

Fields.Name: Comms Effect
Fields.Description: Menu effect shown during a comms conversation.
